title: Admit Engram's show criterion_links argument (and review observations) in the read-only child tracker-read allowlist
outcome: A read-only, non-evaluator delegation child can call Engram show with criterion_links (and its after continuation) once Engram ships that read, and the allowlist decision for the existing observations window is made explicitly.
acceptance: ENGRAM_MCP_READ_TOOLS in src/engram_mcp_config.rs admits `criterion_links` for `show` (with the existing `after`), and only after the Engram build that implements it is the installed and pinned one; the argument is a pure read per the Engram contract recorded on this item.
The existing `observations` show window is either admitted with a stated reason that it only reads, or recorded as deliberately excluded; either way a test pins the decision.
Tests: a read-only child's show call with criterion_links (and with after) is admitted; an unlisted extra argument is still refused; evaluator children still get no tracker tool.
